artifact_schema.description: An assertion and the pinned documents that support it. The checker verifies provenance, never truth.

sources.description: One entry per citation. At least two distinct documents.

document.description: sha256 of the source, which must be one the objective pins.

locator.description: Where in the document, for a human reader.

quote.description: The passage relied on. Must appear verbatim.

text.description: The source document in full. Re-hashed by the checker.

statement: Attest an assertion to its sources. Submit {"assertion", "sources":[{"document","text","quote"}]} citing at least two of the documents this objective pins. The checker re-hashes each supplied text against the cited id and requires every quote to appear verbatim after whitespace folding. IT VERIFIES PROVENANCE, NOT TRUTH: accepting a claim here means the quotations are faithful and the sources are the pinned ones, and says nothing about whether the assertion is correct. No verifier can settle a historical fact, because truth about the world is not a function of an artifact -- see examples/attested-fact/README.md.
